questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

He was going to (1)/ like the clothes, she (2)/ bought of the trip. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution: The error in the sentence lies in part 3. The preposition 'of' should be replaced with the word 'from' to make the sentence grammatically correct.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

"You didn't answer my (1)/ question," he said, (2)/ stepping to her. (3)/No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The erroneous part is 'stepping to her'. It must be replaced by 'stepping up to her'.
 
• The phrase **"stepping up to her"** is used here in the sense of approaching or moving closer to the person mentioned.
 
• The use of "up" gives the sense of reducing the distance or approaching, often with a sense of purpose or intent.

Therefore, the corrected sentence is: ***"You didn't answer my question," he said, stepping up to her.***

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given.**

Consequent
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Ensuing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Consequent"** means something that follows as a result or effect of a previous action or condition. (परिणामी)

 
 
• **Example:** The heavy rainfall and consequent flooding caused widespread damage.
 
 
 
• **"Ensuing"** refers to something that happens or occurs afterward or as a result. (परिणामी)
 
 
• **Example:** The argument and the ensuing chaos disrupted the entire meeting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word similar in meaning to 'Consequent' is 'Ensuing'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Ensuing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inception** (आरंभ): The beginning of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The inception of the new project was marked by a grand ceremony.
 
 
 
• **Dawn** (भोर): The first light of day; the beginning of a phenomenon or period of time.
 
 
• **Example:** The dawn of the digital age has transformed how we communicate.
 
 
 
• **Creation** (सृजन): The action or process of bringing something into existence.
 
 
• **Example:** The creation of the new art piece took several months.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the idiom/phrase.**

options.text: Not able to appreciate the finer things in life
Be excessively prejudiced against something or someone
A clear choice that causes no confusion

questions.solution: The correct answer is: **Option(4) i.e. A clear choice that causes no confusion**. (साफ़ और स्पष्ट) • **Example:** The contract was in black and white, leaving no room for misunderstandings. • **"A clear choice that causes no confusion"** refers to a decision or statement that is straightforward, leaving no ambiguity. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option(4) i.e. A clear choice that causes no confusion**. questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the words/sentence.**

Conformity to facts
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Veracity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Conformity to facts"** means the quality of being in agreement with the facts or reality; the state of being true or accurate. (तथ्यों के अनुरूपता)

 
 
• **Example: **The scientist's research was praised for its conformity to facts.
 
 
 
• **"Veracity"** refers to the adherence to the truth; accuracy or precision. (सत्यता)
 
 
• **Example: **The veracity of his statement was confirmed by multiple sources.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Veracity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deceit** (धोखा): The action or practice of deceiving someone by concealing or misrepresenting the truth.

 
 
• **Example:** His deceit was eventually uncovered, leading to his dismissal.
 
 
 
• **Hypothesis** (परिकल्पना): A supposition or proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation.
 
 
• **Example: **The scientist formulated a hypothesis that required further testing.
 
 
 
• **Theory** (सिद्धांत): A supposition or a system of ideas intended to explain something, based on general principles independent of the thing to be explained.
 
 
• **Example:** Einstein's theory of relativity revolutionized physics.

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

**Then the gigantic figure**

X-alarming spectacle 

Y-slipped off the tree and stood

Z-up before us, a truly
questions.solution: The sentence Y should be the first sentence as none of the other two have a generic continuation to the opening sentence. The next sentence should be Z as the last word of Y is 'stood' and the first world of Z is 'up' and they form a phrase 'stood up'. This automatically makes X the third sentence.The order should be YZX.

**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice.**

No one responded to my online ad.

options.text: My online ad was not responded to by anyone.
My online ad is not responded to by anyone.
Response by no one was given to my online ad.
Response by no one is given to my online ad.

questions.solution: Among the options, 1 would be the most correct alternative. Since option 2 has is, which is incorrect in terms of grammar. Options 3 and 4 are not grammatically correct and would not make for correct options.

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect speech. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct speech.**

Ajay said to my sister, "It's wonderful!"

options.text: Ajay tells my sister that it's wonderful.
Ajay tells to my sister that it was wonderful.
Ajay told my sister that it was wonderful.
Ajay told to my sister that it's being wonderful.

questions.solution: Options 1 and 2 use the word 'tells which is incorrect given the passive voice of the sentence. Option 4 makes use of the word 'being' which is also incorrect since it changes the meaning of the sentence as present in the active voice. The correct option would, therefore, be 3.
